title: Specialty access services across Prescriptions & Renewals classes
content:
Specialty pharmacy services statement. Among the classes of the Prescriptions & Renewals line, the payer's prior authorization, the benefits investigation, copay assistance and medication teaching apply as follows.

| Class | Payer's prior authorization approved before transmission or renewal | Benefits investigation completed within (business days) | Manufacturer or foundation copay assistance offered | Medication teaching completed before the first fill |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Acute Short-Course Prescription | not required | 0 | no | no |
| Standard Maintenance Prescription | not required | 0 | no | no |
| Monitored Maintenance Prescription | not required | 0 | no | yes |
| Schedule III-V Controlled Prescription | not required | 0 | no | no |
| Schedule II Controlled Prescription | not required | 0 | no | no |
| Specialty Medication Prescription | required | 5 | yes | yes |

The Specialty Medication Prescription is the only class for which the payer's prior authorization must be approved before the prescription is transmitted or renewed, the benefits investigation is completed within 5 business days, and copay assistance enrollment is offered. Medication teaching before the first fill is required for two classes: the Monitored Maintenance Prescription and the Specialty Medication Prescription.
